history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

Two anime-style characters stand against a plain white background. The character on the right is closer to the viewer and is in the foreground, extending their right hand forward towards the camera. This character has spiky black hair, sharp features, and markings around their eyes that resemble white tribal patterns with the number "69" subtly integrated into the design on their cheek. They are wearing a dark purple hoodie with a stylized white graphic design on the chest and black pants.

The character on the left is slightly further back and to the left, looking towards the character on the right. This character has reddish-brown hair styled in a braid that hangs down their back and is wearing a dark blue jacket over a brown turtleneck and tan pants. They also wear a dark beanie. The overall style is reminiscent of manga or anime illustrations, with bold line work and vibrant, though somewhat muted, colors. The lighting appears to be even, casting no harsh shadows, which contributes to a clean, graphic aesthetic. The mood is somewhat cool and urban, with a hint of mystery. The artist's signature "@RicardoRiveraART" is visible in the lower left corner.
